teaser: Lacing boots at the open trunk, you check the trailhead map twice before anyone else is out of the car. Life path 11 is yours, and so are the four letters ISTJ. The 11 asks for a kind of knowing that comes early and comes sudden, a flash before the reasoning catches up; ISTJ asks for a second count before the first flash gets acted on. In you the two make a careful kind of mystic: someone who feels the whole trail before taking a step, then ties the laces twice to be sure the feeling wasn't wrong.
excerpt: The hum of brushes and the smell of wet rubber fill the car wash queue, windows up, radio low.
